initial.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent desktop gaze sprite. Edit target image 1 is neutral Steve; preserve same 1536x1024 landscape canvas, camera, bottom-center seated body, hair identity, glasses, slight closed-mouth smirk, navy jacket and white shirt. Change only eye gaze and a very small corresponding head/neck rotation. Keep shoulders and jacket fixed pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible. Lighting locked to neutral: same warm soft key, subtle orange hair rim, identical exposure and white balance, no new glow or backdrop; actual clean transparent alpha outside subject. Coordinates describe VIEWER screen directions x left=-1/right=1, y up=-1/down=1. Full extremes are modest ~16 degree horizontal and ~10 degree vertical turns, so .5 is half that turn. No labels or extra objects. Do not mirror. Produce one intermediate sprite at gaze x=-0.5,y=0: eyes looking halfway left, head yaw about 8 degrees toward viewer left, same slight baseline tilt. This is between neutral and full left.

corrections.prompt: Use case identity-preserve. Correct ONLY the eyeball gaze in this transparent sprite. This is the half-down half-right pose. Both pupils MUST look downward and to the VIEWER'S RIGHT, toward a screen target below and right of the character. Move iris centers visibly into the lower-right region of each sclera; more white above the irises, less white below them. The supplied eyes currently aim too high. Keep head pose, glasses, hair, neck, shoulders, jacket, smile, lighting, exposure, white balance and transparent alpha identical. Do not move or reshape the head or body. Same 1536x1024 canvas. No backdrop.
